title: Repeater: spaced repetition flashcards that live entirely in your terminal
description:
Okay so I just found the most dev-core way to study. It's called repeater — and yes, it's literally flashcards in your terminal. No joke. Your cards are just Markdown files sitting in your repo. You edit them in Obsidian, Vim, whatever. The algorithm? FSRS — targets 90% recall like it's nothing. You drill cards in this clean TUI, create new ones with a built-in editor, check your stats instantly. It's Anki but actually good for developers.

https://github.com/shaankhosla/repeater

#github #opensource
